name: Enemy Weapons: Weapon 3
notes: Roll once for the weapon carried by the basic opponents (except Specialists), then roll for the Specialist weapon if available. Enemies with the Aggressive AI type carry a Blade in addition to any listed weapons, unless their Combat Skill is +0. Enemies with the Psycho AI type always carry a Blade. Some enemies have a specific weapon listed and always carry that. Optional Varied Armaments: split the non-Specialists into two groups and roll for each group.
